senses.gloss: वट- + तल वट- + तल, under a fig-tree, Pañc. 9, 23.

† वट् वट् (a form of वृत्, based on the original वर्त्).
 --i. 1, Par. To [] surround.
 --i. 10, Par., also बट् बट्, वटय, बटय,
 1. To surround.
 2. To tie.
 3. To partition.
 --i. 1, Par. or Caus. वटय, To speak.

वट वट (probably a dialectical form of *वर्त, i. e. वृत् + अ),
 I. m., and f. टी, A string, a rope.
 II. m.
 1. The large Indian fig-tree, Ficus indica, Pañc. 104, 17.
 2. A circle.
 3. Equality in shape or dimension.
 4. A small shell, a cowrie.
 5. Pulse ground and fried with oil or butter.

वाट वाट, i. e. वट + अ,
 I. adj. Made of the Indian fig-tree, Man. 2, 45.
 II. n., f. ती, and n.
 1. An enclosure, Johns. Sel. 40, 36; a grove(?), Bhāg. P. 1, 6, 11 (टी).
 2. A mud wall.
 3. The groin.
 4. A road.
 III. f. ती.
 1. The site of a building.
 2. A house.
 --Comp.

वटक वट + क,
 I. m.
 1. Pulse ground and fried in oil or butter.
 2. A weight of eight माषस्.
 II. f. टिका, A pill, a bolus.

वटर वटर, m.
 1. A cock.
 2. A thief.
 3. A rogue.
 4. A turban (cf. वट).
 5. i. e. वट, = *वर्त, + क, cf. वट, A churning-stick.
 6. A mat.
 7. A fragrant grass, Cyperus.
वटाकर वटाकर (probably वट-आकर, but see the next), m. A cord.
वटारक वटारक, m. A cord, MBh. 3, 12776 (at the end of a comp. adj., f. का); cf. the last and वराटक.
वटारकमय वटारक + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of a cord, MBh. 3, 12785.
वटि वटि, m. A sort of insect.
वटिभ वटि + भ, adj. Having or containing the insects called वटि.

वटु वटु, m.
 1. A young Brāhmaṇa
 2. A pupil, Utt. Rāmac. 104, 9; Prab 22, 3.
 3. A lad, a stripling, Kumāras. 5, 83.
 4. A fool, Śāk. 30, 12.
 5. A flower, Bignonia indica.
वाटधान वाटधान, m. The son of an outcaste Brāhmaṇa by a female Brāhmaṇa, Man. 10, 21.

वाटिका वाटिका, i. e. वाटी + क, f.
 1. The site of a house.
 2. A garden, Pañc. 221, 10.
 --Comp.
वाट्या वाट्या, f., and वाट्याल वाट्या + ल, m., ली, f. A plant, Sida cordifolia, Lass. Pentap. p. 64, v. 10 (ल); p. 66, v. 33 (या) = MBh. 8, 2034; 2059 (vv. rr.)
